system: You are an analyst who writes clear, concise business reports.
prompt:
Write a report of 5 to 8 sentences for the board at Ashgrove on sales results for Q2 2026, based on this data.

Company: Ashgrove
Period: Q2 2026

Data:
- New customers: 1,632 customers
- Change in new customers vs the previous quarter: -25.6%
- Web conversion rate: 1.1%
- Change in web conversion rate vs the previous quarter, in percentage points: -1.5 pp
- Units sold: 47,883 units
- Units sold in the previous quarter: 47,641 units
- Change in units sold vs the previous quarter: 0.5%
- Online orders: 68,420 orders
- Revenue: 3.7 million EUR
- Revenue in the previous quarter: 4 million EUR
- Change in revenue vs the previous quarter: -6.6%
- Return rate: 7.3%
- Verdict on the change in web conversion rate vs the previous quarter, in percentage points: a mild drop

Notes for the report:
[s1] Sales team note, "Seasonal campaign": The Orange Week campaign started on October 22 in Glasgow and Bristol, with discounts of up to 15% on home goods.
[s2] Logistics report, "Delivery delays": For 8 days, deliveries to Glasgow were delayed by a problem with the carrier Swiftway.

Use only the information in the data: do not add figures, names, causes or predictions that are not there. Write only the report, in prose, with no headings or lists.
raw: Q2 2026 delivered €3.7 million in revenue, a 6.6 % decrease from the prior quarter. Units sold rose modestly to 47,883, up 0.5 % quarter‑on‑quarter, while online orders totaled 68,420. New customer acquisition fell to 1,632, marking a 25.6 % decline from the previous quarter. The web conversion rate slipped to 1.1 %, a mild drop of 1.5 percentage points. The return rate held at 7.3 %. The Orange Week seasonal campaign launched on October 22 in Glasgow and Bristol, offering discounts of up to 15 % on home goods. At the same time, deliveries to Glasgow were delayed for eight days due to a carrier issue with Swiftway.
